method.neighbourhood: Cells whose centres lie within 15 km of the CDFW port point.
method.charm_leads: Statistics from the published C-HARM value grids of the current run (same values as the map).
method.charm_history: Median over the same neighbourhood for each C-HARM nowcast in the last 30 days available on ERDDAP; days without a run are absent.
method.chlorophyll: Computed by Neritic from NOAA's daily VIIRS 750 m merges: NOAA-21, with NOAA-20 only in pixels NOAA-21 has no value for (each pixel from one satellite, never averaged). For each date, every pixel's median over an 8-day window (3 days before to 4 after; successive windows overlap), then the median of those pixels within 15 km. Only complete windows are shown. Cloud and land pixels are excluded; a missing value means no clear observation.
method.chlorophyll_source_change: Earlier port summaries used NOAA's S-NPP 8-day composites (erdVHNchla8day); NOAA ends S-NPP data on 2026-11-02. Over California NOAA-21 reads about 4% lower than S-NPP and NOAA-20 about 10% lower (98 days of overlap, Feb-Oct 2026); no correction is applied, so values from before and after the change may differ by about that much. A port whose dataset is erdVHNchla8day still uses the S-NPP composites (fallback while NOAA-21 and NOAA-20 are unavailable).
method.official: A record is related to a port if it is statewide, names the port's county, has official latitudes that include the port, or its official polygon lies within 60 km.

upstream_metadata.change_point: Port chlorophyll switched from erdVHNchla8day (S-NPP 8-day composites) to 8-day windows of the daily NOAA-21/NOAA-20 pixels with this pipeline version; every port's dataset_id names the source of its own values and history.
upstream_metadata.offsets: Measured, not corrected (98 days with all three, Feb-Oct 2026, California, same cells; research/viirs-jpss-overlap/report.md): NOAA-21 reads about 4% lower than S-NPP (median log10 ratio -0.020), NOAA-20 about 10% lower (-0.045); NOAA-21 about 10% higher than NOAA-20 (+0.040). Agreement is poorer within 5 km of shore and above 1 mg m-3.
upstream_metadata.platform_rule: NOAA-21 first; NOAA-20 only in pixels NOAA-21 has no value for. No averaging, no bias correction.
upstream_metadata.window: 8 days, D-3 to D+4; per-pixel median, then the median within 15 km
